goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Rechte/Pflichten von Kapitalgebern und Haftungsrisiken beschreiben.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: An owner and a bank are both capital providers with inward funding arrows, while a large question asks who bears risk and compares private/business asset symbols. It correctly avoids equating funding source with a predetermined liability allocation or promising that lenders never bear loss.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both providers, coin flows, workshop, two asset symbols and risk question remain clear. Decorative workshop signs are unnecessary.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the owner/bank distinction and the unresolved risk balance are easily read without small legal case text.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The bank representative holds a closed BANK folder with a public identifying cover, not an actor-inverted page. No notebook or measurement device is being read.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The drawing asks about risk allocation; rights, duties and precise liability rules depend on the separately reviewed case and legal form.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
